sermon.title: The Birth of Jesus Christ was as Follows... 12/15/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer walks through the birth of Jesus Christ: planned before the foundation of the world, announced to righteous Zechariah and Elizabeth and to Mary, and fulfilled by a virgin birth. John came in the spirit of Elijah to turn people to the Lord. Jesus came to save His people from their sins, and God still answers persistent prayer.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.
